liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Little Red Rooster** (2 reviews): Considered one of the best Little Red Rooster performances the reviewer has heard; Little Red Rooster was great [14][21]
- **Peggy-O** (2 reviews): Peggy-O was nice in the first set; Jerry's vocals are in rare form, with a Dupree's review saying he hadn't sounded like this since early 80s [12][14]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Second set featured a nice jam leading into Terrapin [12]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Morning Dew was remembered as very nice [19]
- **Gloria** (1 review): By Gloria it felt like a hymn, moving enough to make the listener want to change religion [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-03.fob.schoeps.evans.gems.82352.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 153 min; rated 1.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd92-12-03.neumann.vernon.9474.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 16 songs; 149 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Taper hid microphones during the Playing jam, and ankle bells are occasionally audible; overall sound is great; Audience tape has chatter in quiet moments, and the taper repeatedly readjusted microphones [11][17]
- **gd1992-12-03.AKG460.Walker.Darby.120034.Flac1644**: audience recording; 16 songs; 148 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1992-12-03.140249.set1.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 7 songs; 47 min [8]
- **gd1992-12-03.140149.s1.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 7 songs; 47 min [9]

## Around the show

- Dec 2 and 3 were the band's first shows after Jerry's near-fatal illness; the 2nd felt tentative, the 3rd confident [10]
- Reviewer helped make a front-of-board style tape that night using B&K 4011 microphones [11]
- West Coast fall tour was cancelled; these Denver shows were the first after Jerry's health improved [12]
- A blizzard moved into Denver during the show, surprising everyone afterward [14]
- Two brothers sold homemade burritos from a cooler outside the arena before the show, swarmed by hungry Deadheads [15]
- Drive home from Denver to Boulder through the blizzard was perilous [16]
- Crowd was glad to get in from the cold and approaching storm; howls echoed around arena [19]
- Sound behind the stage was terrible, and many people left within two minutes of the start [19]
- The 3rd show was far stronger than the uncertain 2nd night [10]
- Second set is called outstanding from start to finish, much stronger than the first set [11]
- Second set was far better than the sub-par show the night before; first set was solid [16]
- Encores on both nights were the reviewer's highlight; this night's encore followed a rain surprise on the other [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-03.fob.schoeps.evans.gems.82352.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Schoeps Mk4v Cardiod Capslue (ORTF) -> Schopes Kc5 Active Cable -> Schoeps CMC3 Mic Body -> Oade Mic Pre -> Monster M1000 Jumper Cable (12" -> Panasonic sv255… [1]
- **gd92-12-03.neumann.vernon.9474.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [2]
- **gd1992-12-03.AKG460.Walker.Darby.120034.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby and Rob Walker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Walker And Mr. Darby; AKGC460B/CK61's (DIN/Section FFF,Row 3, Seat 4/6 Feet High)> AKGB18 (With 48 Volt Transformers)>Sony… [3]
- **gd1992-12-03.140249.set1.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [8]. Also: Soundboard fileset in 16 bit covers only the first set; second set is missing [8]
- **gd1992-12-03.140149.s1.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [9]. Also: Soundboard fileset in 24-bit/96k format contains only set one; second set is missing [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-12-03 McNichols Sports Arena, Denver, CO, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-03-mcnichols-sports-arena-denver-co-usa/) [23]
